evidence.currentRole: https://business-school.exeter.ac.uk/management/people/profile/index.php?username=ttn209 — “Dr Thanh T. Nguyen”, “Lecturer”, “Operations and Analytics”. Live individual employer page opened successfully. It identifies previous teaching at Middlesex and IÉSEG and lists current 2026–2027 Exeter modules alongside earlier modules. Normal substantive UK academic lectureship; no visiting, honorary, postdoctoral or temporary qualifier. Department and operations/project-management interests are explicit on this page.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: https://pure.qub.ac.uk/en/activities/dissertation-committee-kellan-tuan-nguyen/ — fetched directly with HTTP 200 after the web reader returned a cache miss; identifies Kellan Tuan Nguyen, PhD external examination at National Tsing-Hua University, examiner R. Nishant. https://www.iss.nthu.edu.tw/faculty/Pei-Fang-Hsu — opened and also fetched directly with HTTP 200; the complete HTML identifies Tuan Kellan Nguyen as the supervised recipient of a 2021 doctoral-dissertation award (博士論文獎). https://www.ieseg.fr/en/news/new-professors-2021-2022-academic-year/ — opened, independently documents his subsequent postdoctoral appointment as Tuan Thanh Nguyen. Together these corroborate the doctorate; no graduation year inferred from award/examination dates. Current research is independently supported by https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10257-024-00690-2 (opened, Tuan Kellan Nguyen explicitly affiliated with Exeter; published October 2024, volume 2025) and https://dblp.dagstuhl.de/pid/288/9389.html (opened, 2024 European Journal of Information Systems article with Nishant, Teo and Hsu).
evidence.vietnameseSignal: Vietnamese given-name tokens Thanh and Tuan with Nguyen. Current employer publishes Thanh T. Nguyen and directly links ORCID 0000-0003-1248-9555. Publication discovery under Tuan (Kellan) Nguyen exposes exactly that ORCID and T.T.Nguyen@exeter.ac.uk, with the same Exeter operations appointment and Middlesex/IÉSEG history. The NTHU doctorate evidence resolves the Tuan/Kellan publication identity. Retained the current employer display name; no expansion of its initial or Vietnamese diacritics invented.
evidence.dedup: Ran npm run find-roster-matches for both Thanh T. Nguyen and Tuan (Kellan) Nguyen, with the employer profile, https://experts.exeter.ac.uk/41266-thanht-nguyen, https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1248-9555 and https://dblp.org/pid/416/2599.html. No identity-URL match. Manually checked current and retired matches. Tuan-name hits vp-0308 (Vanderbilt education PhD), vp-0609 (Nottingham computer-science PhD; independently opened Greenwich profile), vp-0830/vp-0867 (clinical physicians), vp-1877 (German sociology), vp-2151 (Oregon economics PhD) and vp-2974 (Iowa State/security) are different people. Thanh-name hits include vp-0166 (Cornell/Purdue quantitative methods), vp-1807 (Griffith/JCU), and engineering, clinical and computing researchers with other degrees/identity URLs; none matches Exeter email, linked ORCID, NTHU/Hsu doctoral history or Middlesex/IÉSEG career. Examined earlier-run records behind already-proposed.txt: exact short names Thanh Nguyen (Nebraska Medical Center emergency-medicine research) and Tuan Nguyen (NIAAA biophotonics) are different identities; no earlier Exeter/Kellan proposal found. The current employer name is not in the skip list.
evidence.enrichment: Research-area labels limited to employer teaching expertise and the opened Springer paper. Exeter Discovery is a JavaScript shell and yielded no additional facts. Publisher EJIS bio was discoverable but live publisher returned 403; no unsupported degree year or award imported from that blocked page. NTHU dissertation award is trainee-stage and deliberately omitted from honors. No verified personal homepage, Scholar profile, LinkedIn or vetted portrait found; no LinkedIn page fetched. City omitted because no person-specific location was established.
